launch() then continues: navigateToGameDocument(initial) sets src=<redacted-src> wrapper loads; nested game document request reaches the resource origin after the instance was released -> 403 (GM-4011) -> frame becomes chrome-error://, no game resources.

verdict: CONFIRMED runtime bug (not probe artifact): the wrapper fix needs to ignore the initial about:blank load (assign iframe/src before appendChild, or arm expectedFrameLoads before appending, or skip load events whose target has no src).
